meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 只读拉取当前仓库所有未关闭的 issue 与 PR，一项一个后台子代理分析，把逐条报告写到 /tmp/{datetime}/ 下，每条结论都以 GitHub permalink 为证据；全程不会在 GitHub 上做任何写改动。
howto.when: 当用户说出 “triage”、“triage issues”、“github triage” 等词，或要求做仓库 triage 时接管。会先抓取全部未关闭 issue 与 PR，再逐项分析。

say.text: 对本仓库跑一次 triage，把未关闭 issue 和 PR 逐条写成分析报告。
say.note: 每一条会单独生成一个 md 文件。

say.text: 执行 triage issues，查清每个 bug 的原因并给出代码出处。
say.note: 报告会写进 /tmp 下带时间戳的文件夹。

say.text: 跑一遍 github triage，只分析，别改动 GitHub 上的任何东西。
say.note: 技能本来就是只读，不会发评论、合并或关闭。

howto.what_en: Fetches all open issues and PRs of the current repo, analyzes each in a separate background subagent, and writes per-item reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim must carry a GitHub permalink. It never mutates GitHub: no comments, merges, closes, or labels.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage', or asks for a triage of the repo. It then lists all open issues and PRs and analyzes each one.

say_en.text: Run triage on this repo and report on every open issue and PR.
say_en.note: Each item gets its own markdown report file.

say_en.text: Run triage issues and pinpoint each bug with evidence links.
say_en.note: Reports go to a timestamped folder in /tmp.

say_en.text: Run github triage — read only; don't change anything on GitHub.
say_en.note: No comments, merges or closes will be made.
